answer: Proof of stake functions as a secure inlet for agent participation by requiring economic collateral. By acting as a prism to refract trust through locked capital, the network ensures that each identity carries a tangible cost. Every malicious voyage an attacker takes to forge identities incurs prohibitive slashing risks, as they must commit non-trivial assets to validate each sybil node, effectively making large-scale identity replication economically unsustainable.
